name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (domain=promote, descriptor=member_select_loop) and accurately reflects the purpose: the CLASS-PROMOTION member-select grid loop. The singular form is a deliberate, meaningful distinction from the plural fd2_promote_members_select_loop @ 0x30C22 (church-revive picker); both are documented as distinct. No Ghidra address residue, no spurious suffix. Keep.
purpose: Class-promotion candidate-selection grid loop: opens the candidate panel, slides it down, runs Up/Down navigation, and returns whether the user committed (1) or cancelled (-1). Sole caller is the class-promotion menu.
logic_summary: result=0. malloc 3x 64000-byte (mode 13h) workspaces (anim accumulator / bg snapshot / composed target). Snapshot VGA 0xA0000 -> bg_snapshot -> composed_target. Reset menu state globals: scroll_offset=0, cursor_idx=0, candidate_array_ptr=char_list_ptr, visible_item_count=char_count. Blit the dialog frame sprite into composed_target+0x8C05 (sprite atlas entry at atlas+0x46). Render the candidate grid via the 5-arg fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid (passes char_count, composed_target, cursor_idx, char_list_ptr, target_class_list_ptr). Slide-down reveal: frame_iter 5..0, fd2_slide_panel_down_step(frame_iter*0xD+0x70, anim, composed_target). Input loop (do/while result==0): scancode=fd2_wait_input_with_chapter_dialog_blink(2); Up(0x48) decrements cursor (with scroll_offset-- + fd2_animate_scroll_down_in_shop_dialog when cursor < scroll_offset) and re-renders to 0xA0000; Down(0x50) increments cursor while < char_count-1 (with scroll_offset++ + fd2_animate_scroll_up_in_shop_dialog when cursor-scroll_offset > 2) and re-renders to 0xA0000; Enter(0x1C)/Space(0x39) -> result=1; ESC(0x01) -> result=-1. Returns result. Buffers are NOT freed here (caller's job via fd2_close_intro_dialog_with_slide_out).

params.name: char_count
params.semantics: Number of promotion candidates in the list (caller passes the count returned by fd2_build_promotion_candidates_with_targets). Used to set visible_item_count, bound the Down navigation (cursor < char_count-1), and as the grid renderer's candidate count.

params.name: char_list_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to the per-candidate runtime_char index byte array (caller passes candidate_chars[]). Stored into data_fd2_ui_menu_candidate_array_ptr and forwarded to the grid renderer to resolve each visible row's char.

params.name: price_aux_list_ptr
params.semantics: Pointer to the per-candidate POST-PROMOTION TARGET-CLASS id byte array (caller passes target_classes[]). It is NOT a price list: in fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid @ 0x31019 it is read as target_list[scroll_offset+iter] and fed to fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry to render each candidate's 'current job -> target job' arrow.
params.reason: Current name 'price_aux_list_ptr' is misleading (likely a leftover analogy to the revive menu's per-job price table). Verified via the renderer fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid @ 0x31019: the 5th arg is the per-candidate target-class id list used to draw the post-promotion target job, with zero price semantics. Rename recorded only; to be applied in Stage 2 (touches protos.h + the sole call site in fd2_run_class_promotion_menu_main).

returns.semantics: 1 = committed (Enter 0x1C or Space 0x39); -1 = cancelled (ESC 0x01). The function loops until one of these is set (result stays 0 while only navigating).

comment_original_issue: The src comment's third-param description anchored on the misleading name 'price_aux_list_ptr' (calling it a price/aux ptr) even though it is the per-candidate post-promotion target-class list. Refined to describe the param by its true role and how the renderer consumes it (target class -> fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry -> target-job arrow), removing the misleading price framing.
notes: Verified the third-param semantics against fd2_render_promote_candidates_grid @ 0x31019: the list is read as target_list[scroll_offset+iter] and passed to fd2_get_class_promotion_data_entry (post-promotion target-class id), confirming it is a target-class list, not a price list. Body matches decompile exactly; no logic concerns. Ghidra plate was stale (old global names render_workspace_a/b/c, chapter_intro_face_*, current_menu_cursor_idx; param described as 'price/aux list ptr') and was rewritten to match current src-derived understanding, then saved. name_final=current (keep); only the third param name is flagged for Stage-2 rename.
